title: Reactions in WhatsApp groups
text: You can now react to a message in a WhatsApp group from TD Social, and the reaction goes to the group. When a group member reacts to a message, you see their reaction with their first name, one for each person, instead of nothing.
points: React to a group message from the CRM

steps.name: Open a group chat
steps.detail: The one with the green Group label.

steps.name: Pick a reaction on a message
steps.detail: The same smiley button as in other chats.

steps.name: See members' reactions
steps.detail: Each pill shows the member's first name.
